blocks.html: Not all pre-rolls are created equal, and if you’ve ever dealt with canoeing, harsh hits, or a joint that won’t stay lit, you already know that.
At Star Buds, we carry pre-rolls that actually smoke the way they’re supposed to. Here’s what separates a top-tier pre-roll from one you’ll regret lighting.
It’s Not Just Shake (At Least It Shouldn’t Be)
Low-quality pre-rolls are often packed with trim or leftover shake. Quality pre-rolls use ground flower, preserving flavor, potency, and smoothness.
Pro tip: If the pre-roll tastes harsh or burns unevenly, that’s usually a quality issue—not user error.
Too fine? It burns too fast and clogs airflow.Too chunky? It won’t stay lit.
This is one of the biggest reasons dispensary-grade pre-rolls outperform anything rolled at home with leftovers.
